The Court made the following:
Order:

The grievance of the petitioners is non-disposal of their arbitration application filed under section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956, for redetermination of the compensation amount in respect of their land acquired for widening NH-365BG, despite lapse of considerable time.

2. Heard Sri P.Hema Chandra, learned counsel for the petitioners, and the learned Assistant Government Pleaders for Revenue and for Land Acquisition.
3.

Sri P.Hema Chandra, learned counsel for the petitioners, while reiterating the contents of the writ affidavit further contended that, the petitioners, dissatisfied with the quantum of compensation fixed by the Competent Authority for Land Acquisition (CALA), filed Arbitration application before the Authority for determination of the compensation and despite lapse of considerable time the said Authority has not disposed of the same.
Therefore, a direction may be given to the Authority for expeditious disposal of the said Arbitration Application.

4. Whereas the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition, by placing the written instructions dated 07.02.2024 on record, submitted that the Arbitration Application filed by the petitioner was received on 16.02.2023 for redetermination of the compensation and as many as 200 applications have been filed for arbitration in respect of the lands acquired for the projection NH365BG.

The learned Assistant Government Pleader further submitted that the Arbitrator-cum-District Collector would take up the applications for hearing and sought four (04)
months time for taking up the applications for hearing.
5. The learned counsel for the petitioners reported no objection for granting four (04) months time as sought for by the learned Assistant Government Pleader.

6. In view of the above, since the learned counsel for the petitioners agreed for granting four (04)
months time for disposal of the arbitration application filed by the petitioners as sought for by the Duggirala Nagamani vs Union Of India on 12 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10603163/

There shall be no order as to costs.

As a sequel, Interlocutory Applications, pending if any, shall stand closed and interim orders, if any,
shall stand vacated.
